**Daily Devotional**

**March 12**

*15 And when the servant of the man of God was risen early, and gone forth, behold, an host compassed the city both with horses and chariots. And his servant said unto him, Alas, my master! how shall we do? 16 And he answered, Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them. 17 And Elisha prayed, and said, LORD, I pray thee, open his eyes, that he may see. And the LORD opened the eyes of the young man; and he saw: and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. (2 Kings 6:15-17 KJV)*

When this servant of Elisha saw the Syrian army surrounding them, he panicked. This is such a marvelous example of seeing by faith, as Elisha knew the chariots of fire were all around them, but the servant didn’t see them with his natural vision. If we would just walk in faith enough to be able to see the unseen, by faith, we also would know that God always protects those who love and serve Him (Psalms 34:7). God made the angels for the purpose of ministering to those who would become saints (believers) (Hebrews 1:14), and they are all around us.

If a Christian can get to where they walk by faith, more than sight, you would be amazed at what all you would see, as there is an unseen spirit world out there, and our natural vision just cannot see it. This is what Jesus was telling us when He said “they seeing see not” (Matthew 13:13). Seeing by faith is better than seeing by sight (2 Corinthians 5:7 and Hebrews 11:1). The Word of God is the key to being able to walk in faith to the degree that you can see by faith (Romans 10:17). Praise God for giving us His faith in the fruit of the Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23), when we are born again, and filled with the Holy Ghost. Thank you Jesus.
